source_text: Qui mortem Christi recipiunt, consortes mortis eius fiunt; qui virtutem Spiritus recipiunt, quia ipse in specie columbae apparuit, etiam ipsi columbae fiunt, pennis Spiritus ad caelestia sublevati.
pass_a_gloss: Who death of-Christ receive, partners of-death his become; who power of-Spirit receive, because he himself in form of-dove appeared, also themselves doves become, by-wings of-Spirit toward heavenly things lifted.
pass_b_english: Those who receive Christ’s death become [[partners in the likeness of his death >> Bible:Romans 6:5]]; those who receive the Spirit’s power, because he himself appeared in the form of a dove, themselves become doves, lifted by the Spirit’s wings toward the heavenly.
